title: JEV Trading Desk V1.2 — Session Isolation Evidence

engine_integrity.fixed_in: isolation adapter layer (server/trading_api.mjs, server/lib/d1_adapter.mjs) — NOT in frozen engine

defects_fixed.root_cause: Audit route did not pass through readSession gateway; unauthenticated paperAudit() returned ALL sessions' orders/fills/events.
defects_fixed.fix: Gate the audit route with readSession(preq, env) before paperAudit(); unauthenticated call now returns 401 fail-closed.
defects_fixed.verified: isolation_http.json anonymous_audit_rejected=true; isolation_browser.json anonymous_audit_rejected=true; live curl POST /api/jev/paper/audit => 401

defects_fixed.root_cause: Migration 0003 contained DROP paper_orders + rename + double scaling; replay on restart triggered FOREIGN KEY / UNIQUE crashes.
defects_fixed.fix: Added schema_migrations idempotency tracking; register pre-existing schema; skip applied migrations; clean up *_fp residue tables on completion.
defects_fixed.verified: Adapter restart no longer crashes; health=200; runtime DB continues to serve across restarts.

L1_engine_data_isolation.summary: Frozen engine imported onto an INDEPENDENT throwaway SQLite (not the live runtime DB). Real market orders placed for two sessions under a market stub.

L2_live_adapter_http_dual_session.summary: Two independent cookie jars (two Chrome 'Profiles') driving the LIVE adapter on :4791 over real HTTP.

L3_real_browser_two_chrome_profiles.summary: Two independent --user-data-dir Chrome instances (separate cookie jars). Browser auto-stores and returns a per-profile Secure session cookie; all authenticated requests rely on credentials:include.

cross_session_leak_verification.p0_requirement: E2E runs multiple times must not accumulate orders/positions across sessions
cross_session_leak_verification.result: PASS — each session is scoped by session_id; audit/account/orders/fills/events are all session-scoped via readSession gateway. Anonymous access returns 401 (fail-closed), never a shared default account.

contract_unification.p1_requirement: GET /api/jev/paper/session must not return 405; unify GET/POST contract
contract_unification.result: PASS — handlePaperSession accepts only POST (GET => 405 by design at the authoritative engine). The frontend (PaperAccount.tsx) no longer polls session via GET; removed the spurious 405 request. Cookie policy: Path=/api/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict.

stable_business_keys.requirement: All list keys use stable business IDs, not index fallbacks
stable_business_keys.result: PASS — positions keyed by symbol, orders by order id, fills/events by id/seq across PaperAccount.tsx and TradingWorkbench.tsx.
